repositories.name: langgraph
repositories.description: Build resilient language agents with durable execution, state, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
repositories.readme: LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework for long-running, stateful agents. Install the Python package and follow the official quickstart.
repositories.summary_zh: LangGraph 是面向长时间运行、具备状态的 AI Agent 编排框架，重点解决持久化执行、人工介入和失败恢复。适合需要精细控制工作流与状态生命周期的代理应用。
repositories.quick_start: Python · 先运行官方 Quickstart，理解 State、节点与边，再尝试持久化和人工介入。

repositories.name: vllm
repositories.description: A high-throughput, memory-efficient inference and serving engine for large language models.
repositories.readme: vLLM provides high-throughput model serving and an OpenAI-compatible API. Start with the installation guide and the official serving example.
repositories.summary_zh: vLLM 是以高吞吐和显存效率为核心的大模型推理服务引擎，提供 OpenAI 兼容接口与连续批处理能力。适合部署重视并发性能和硬件利用率的模型服务。
repositories.quick_start: Python / GPU · 先按官方安装指南确认硬件兼容，再启动 OpenAI 兼容服务并发送一个最小请求。

repositories.name: deepeval
repositories.description: An open-source framework for evaluating LLM systems and agents.
repositories.readme: DeepEval provides metrics and test cases for evaluating LLM applications. Install the package and run the introductory evaluation example.
repositories.summary_zh: DeepEval 把 LLM 应用的质量要求写成可重复执行的测试用例与评测指标，可覆盖 RAG、Agent 和回答质量。适合在本地开发与 CI 中持续验证模型行为。
repositories.quick_start: Python · 选择一个内置评测指标，为单条模型回答编写并运行首个测试用例。

repositories.name: langfuse
repositories.description: An open-source platform for LLM observability, evaluation, prompt management, and datasets.
repositories.readme: Langfuse connects LLM traces with evaluations, metrics, prompts, and datasets. Use the local Docker Compose setup to inspect a sample trace.
repositories.summary_zh: Langfuse 将 LLM 调用链路、评测、提示词版本和数据集集中到一套开源平台中，便于定位质量、延迟与成本问题。适合为线上 AI 应用补齐可观测性和持续评估。
repositories.quick_start: Docker · 用 Compose 启动本地实例，再接入一个已有 LLM 调用并查看首条 Trace。

repositories.name: llama_index
repositories.description: Build document agents and retrieval-augmented applications over private or public data.
repositories.readme: LlamaIndex provides data connectors, indexes, retrieval, and agent workflows. Install the Python package and follow the starter tutorial.
repositories.summary_zh: LlamaIndex 提供数据连接、索引、检索和 Agent 工作流组件，帮助应用把文档与业务数据接入大模型。适合构建 RAG、文档问答和知识型代理。
repositories.quick_start: Python · 按 Starter Tutorial 接入一份小文档，完成索引、检索和一次带来源的问答。

repositories.name: ollama
repositories.description: Run and manage large language models locally through a simple command-line and API workflow.
repositories.readme: Ollama packages local model execution behind a CLI and API. Install a release, pull a supported model, and run the first chat command.
repositories.summary_zh: Ollama 用统一的命令行和本地 API 简化模型下载、运行与管理，让开发者无需搭建复杂推理服务即可在电脑上调用大模型。适合本地原型、离线实验和私有数据场景。
repositories.quick_start: CLI · 安装后拉取一个体积较小的模型，先完成一次命令行对话，再测试本地 HTTP API。

repositories.name: promptfoo
repositories.description: Test prompts, agents, and RAG systems with declarative evaluations and security checks.
repositories.readme: Promptfoo runs versioned LLM test cases locally and in CI. Install the CLI, create a configuration file, and run the first evaluation.
repositories.summary_zh: Promptfoo 使用声明式配置批量比较提示词、模型和 RAG 或 Agent 流程，并提供红队与漏洞测试。适合把效果评测和安全回归纳入日常开发与 CI。
repositories.quick_start: TypeScript / CLI · 创建最小配置，放入两个提示词或模型组合，运行一次本地对比评测。

repositories.name: phoenix
repositories.description: Open-source AI observability and evaluation for tracing, experiments, and troubleshooting.
repositories.readme: Phoenix helps trace and evaluate LLM applications and agents. Install the package and launch the local observability quickstart.
repositories.summary_zh: Phoenix 是面向 LLM 与 Agent 的开源可观测和评测平台，可追踪调用链、分析实验并排查检索或模型输出问题。适合本地调试和持续质量监控。
repositories.quick_start: Python · 启动本地 Phoenix，导入或生成一段 LLM Trace，再查看调用链和评测结果。

repositories.name: smolagents
repositories.description: A compact agent library focused on readable code-driven tool use.
repositories.readme: Smolagents provides a concise agent runtime with code and tool use. Install the package and run the first tool-calling example.
repositories.summary_zh: Smolagents 是强调轻量与可读性的 Agent 库，让模型通过代码或工具完成任务。适合学习代理执行循环，或快速搭建不需要复杂框架的实验原型。
repositories.quick_start: Python · 运行官方工具调用示例，先观察 Agent 如何选择工具，再替换成自己的简单函数。

repositories.name: llm-guard
repositories.description: A security toolkit for scanning, filtering, and sanitizing LLM inputs and outputs.
repositories.readme: LLM Guard provides input and output scanners for common LLM risks. Install the package and start with the scanner usage examples.
repositories.summary_zh: LLM Guard 提供输入与输出扫描器，在请求进入模型前后检测并清洗提示注入、敏感信息和不安全内容。适合给现有 LLM 应用增加可组合的安全防护层。
repositories.quick_start: Python · 选择一个输入扫描器和一个输出扫描器，先对 README 示例文本跑通检测与清洗流程。
